Highly recommended
Sep 2026 • Family
We loved MET so much that we came back several times during our stay in Hanoi!

The food is absolutely delicious, the prices are very reasonable, and the service is excellent. Every meal we had here was a great experience.

A special thank you to our waiter, Noah, who was incredibly kind, attentive and welcoming. He took the time to explain the dishes and even taught us the proper way to eat them, which made the experience even more special and authentic.

Definitely one of our favorite restaurants in Hanoi. Highly recommended! ❤️
